source.name: Score and Change, Overview of the 2026/2027 La Liga sponsors
source.quote: Three clubs – Elche and promoted sides Málaga and Racing Santander – have even agreed with the same company MGS Seguros.

note: Value not disclosed. MGS Seguros has been a Málaga CF partner since 2024/25 (club announcement of 2024-07-09, then on the left trouser leg); 2Playbook (2026-08-10): 'el club ha vendido la manga a MGS Seguros'.
